title: Implement Robust Error Handling Mechanism
description: A robust error handling mechanism is crucial for a production-ready framework like yantraverse, as it ensures that errors are properly logged and handled, providing valuable insights for debugging and improvement. This feature will introduce a centralized error handling system, allowing for better error management and logging. By doing so, it will significantly enhance the overall stability and reliability of the framework.
testCases: Test error handling for route not found
Test error handling for server errors
acceptance: The error handling mechanism should be able to catch and log errors properly, providing detailed error messages and stack traces for debugging purposes. The framework should also be able to recover from errors and continue running without crashes.
reason: Implementing a robust error handling mechanism is essential for a production-ready framework, as it directly impacts the user experience and overall reliability of the application.
